title: FinFET Inspection - Overlay Shift Detection on ATL/LMS IPRO8
subtitle: Post-Oxidation Quality Validation for 10nm Node Manufacturing
author: Dr. Thomas Mueller

sections.1_OBJECTIVE:
This test case validates the capability of the ATL/LMS IPRO8 system to detect and classify Overlay Shift defects during post-oxidation inspection at the 10nm technology node. The test is conducted at Milpitas Fab A to ensure manufacturing quality standards are met for 200mm wafer production.

The primary objective is to verify that the inspection system meets the required detection sensitivity and classification accuracy for Overlay Shift defects that are critical to yield at the 10nm node. This test case is part of the ongoing qualification program for the ATL/LMS IPRO8 platform.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Product Line: ATL/LMS IPRO8
- Inspection Type: FinFET Inspection
- Target Defect: Overlay Shift
- Process Step: Post-Oxidation
- Wafer Size: 200mm
- Technology Node: 10nm
- Fab Location: Milpitas Fab A

This test case applies to all ATL/LMS IPRO8 systems deployed at Milpitas Fab A for post-oxidation monitoring in the 10nm manufacturing line. Results from this test are used to establish baseline performance metrics and to qualify new recipe configurations.
sections.3_TEST_CONFIGURATION:
System: ATL/LMS IPRO8
Software Version: v15.0.747
Recipe: FINFET_INSPECTION_10nm_POST_OXIDATION
Illumination Mode: Darkfield
Scan Speed: Low (72 mm/s)
Pixel Size: 0.5μm
Edge Exclusion: 4mm
Sampling Plan: 21-point sampling
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Power on the ATL/LMS IPRO8 system and allow 30-minute warm-up period.
2. Load the calibration wafer and run the standard calibration routine.
3. Verify calibration results are within specification (±2% tolerance).
4. Load the test wafer onto the stage using the automated handler.
5. Select the 'FinFET Inspection' recipe from the recipe library.
6. Configure detection sensitivity to target Overlay Shift defects.
7. Set scan parameters: full wafer scan with edge exclusion of 3mm.
8. Initiate the inspection run and monitor real-time defect map.
9. Upon completion, review the defect density map and classification results.
10. Export results to the factory automation system (SECS/GEM interface).
11. Compare results against the golden reference baseline.
12. Document any anomalies and generate the summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Defect detection sensitivity must meet 10nm node requirements
- False positive rate shall not exceed 5% of total detected events
- Scan throughput must be ≥ 95 wafers per hour
- Classification accuracy shall be ≥ 98% for known defect types
- Repeatability (3-sigma) shall be within ±2.0% for FinFET Inspection
- System uptime during test shall be ≥ 98%
- All results must be traceable through the MES integration
- Measurement correlation with reference tool shall be ≥ 0.95 R²
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Test Execution Date: 2024-06-09
Wafers Tested: 16
Total Defects Found: 2978
Defect Density: 947.93 defects/cm²
Nuisance Rate: 0.9%
Capture Rate: 94.5%
Test Duration: 149 minutes
System Uptime: 98.4%

Result Classification: NEEDS REVIEW
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The ATL/LMS IPRO8 demonstrated below-target performance in detecting Overlay Shift at the 10nm node.

b) The capture rate exceeded the minimum threshold, confirming system readiness.

c) Nuisance rate is within acceptable limits.

d) Cross-correlation with the reference SEM confirmed classification accuracy.

e) SECS/GEM communication was verified with zero packet loss during data transfer.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
The following corrective actions are recommended:

1. Review edge-zone detection parameters for optimization.
2. Schedule follow-up test after recipe optimization.
3. Monitor performance over next 30 production days.
